name: Fast Corp Ltd.
description: Fully online Bulgarian company formation + accounting / compliance desk — company ready in 3–5 business days, 10% corporate tax pitch, EU IBAN & banking support (company-stated). Founded (TrustMRR profile), BG. Team 2–5. ~3,000 estimated users. Channels: Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, Meta Ads, partnerships. Domain fastcorp.eu (DR 4).

mentions.evidence: ~$8.6k L30, ~$56k all-time, MRR not listed as seat subscriptions (formation + service mix). Founded Jul 2025 on TrustMRR profile (ops claim longer history), Bulgaria. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one low-tax / high-bureaucracy EU (or LatAm) jurisdiction and sell remote incorporation + bookkeeping as a productized firm. Switching costs explode once VAT and payroll live there.

mentions.evidence: ~$0 MRR, 0 active subscriptions, ~$8,645 L30 (0.0% growth on snapshot), ~$56,373 all-time, ~70% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 10, 2026 ~07:57 Warsaw (05:57 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: "Polish LTD / Estonian OÜ / Bulgarian EOOD in a box" comparison funnel for indie SaaS founders who want an EU company + VAT + Stripe, sold as a €799 formation package + €99/mo bookkeeping. Partner with one local accountant; own the SEO for "open EU company as non-resident."

whyItPrints: Cross-border company formation is bureaucracy glue — same lane as Get Brazil Visa / Easy Moving Permits / P7M.io. $0 MRR with ~$8.6k L30 and ~70% L30 margin means one-time formation packages (+ maybe bookkeeping upsells) rather than seats. Ads-heavy acquisition on a low-DR domain; the product is the process, not the brand.
